description_expanded: ABOUT BEACH BALL Get ready to bounce into vacation mode at Beach Ball - a bright and breezy coastal getaway just steps from the powder-soft sands of Panama City Beach. With 5 bedrooms, 5 bathrooms, and room for up to 15 guests, this playful retreat was made for large families and friend groups who love sunshine, salty air, and spending quality time together. Spanning multiple floors and featuring its own private elevator, Beach Ball brings comfort and convenience to every corner. Each bedroom is thoughtfully appointed with its own bathroom, offering a mix of king suites, cozy queen sleeper sofas, and a standout bunk room that kids (and the young at heart) will love. With complimentary WiFi, four designated parking spaces, a private garage, Beach Ball has all the conveniences you need to feel right at home. From the Gulf views to the easy access to a sparkling community pool, Beach Ball sets the tone for memory-making. Whether you're blending up frozen drinks in the fully equipped kitchen, catching a coastal breeze after a beach day, or lounging in the living room with sandy toes and a sun-kissed glow, every space at Beach Ball is the perfect place to help you slow down, soak it in, and live the laid-back beach life to the fullest. Beach Ball isn't just a beach house-it's your new go-to vacation spot. ABOUT THE AREA Beach Ball is nestled on the serene west end of Panama City Beach - a laid-back stretch of coastline where white sands, turquoise waves, and a slower pace of life set the tone for your stay. Here, the mornings begin with beach walks and coffee in hand, and the days unfold with sunshine, salty breezes, and endless coastal charm. Just a short stroll puts you on the soft shores of the Gulf, where you can swim, build sandcastles, or simply relax under a beach umbrella. Prefer to stay close? The nearby community pool offers a refreshing option for a midday dip. When adventure calls, you're just minutes from the lively buzz of Pier Park - home to boutique shops, entertainment, live music, and local seafood eateries serving up fresh catches and waterfront views. This side of Panama City Beach is known for being family-friendly and refreshingly uncrowded, giving you the perfect mix of peaceful retreat and access to excitement. Beach Ball puts you at the heart of it all. PROPERTY HIGHLIGHTS: * Steps from the Beach * Gulf View * Spacious Balcony * Private home * Elevator * Fully Equipped Kitchen * Sleeper Sofas * Smart TVs * WiFi * Community Pool * Private Garage PARKING: 4 Designated Parking Spots PROPERTY RULES: * Must sign rental agreement within 48 hours of booking or subject to cancellation * Must be 25 years or older to book * Pets not permitted * Smoking not permitted * All reservations are non-refundable - we strongly encourage purchasing travel insurance to protect your trip ABOUT PARADISE PROPERTIES: When you book your vacation in Florida's Panhandle with Paradise Properties Vacation Rentals and Sales, you can expect first-class customer service from the moment you inquire. All of our properties are professionally cleaned, inspected, and maintained to the highest standard. Our team is local and available 24/7 to ensure your stay is seamless and stress-free. Our mission is to help you create lasting memories, one beach vacation at a time. DISCLOSURE: Please be aware this area has a lot of development and new construction going on. At any given point adjacent properties to properties we manage may go under construction to which we are not notified. Paradise Properties is not liable for any construction happening outside of the properties we manage.

Location: Less Than a 5 Minute Walk to the Beach
